title: Notification regarding the Single Bench and Division Bench matters of all Judges (including Hon'ble The Chief Justice) scheduled to be listed on 26.09.2026 will be listed on 10.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
(including Hon’ble the Chief Justice) scheduled to be listed on 26.09.2026 (Saturday)

Court will sit at 12:00 noon on 28.09.2026.

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 7th September, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that on account of other official duties of Hon’ble The Chief Justice, Hon'ble Mr.
Justice A. Birnol Singh and Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma [i.e. For
participation/speaking as panelists in a Two-Day Eastern Zone Regional
Conference relating to Family Court Matters at Guwahati, Assam on 26-27
September, 2026 organized by the Committee for Family Court Matters, Supreme
Court of India in association with Gauhati High Court], there will be no Saturday
Court sitting and the Single Bench and Division Bench matters of all Hon’ble Judges
(including Hon’ble the Chief Justice) scheduled to be listed on 26.09.2026 (Saturday)
will be listed on 10.10.2026 (Saturday).
Court will sit at 12:00 noon on 28.09.2026.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ ! g#32- b-' Imphal, the 7th September, 2026
